name: Strakture
author: Aleksandr Samokhin

sections.description:
Strakture is an AI-powered WordPress block pattern library that generates layouts matched to your theme’s actual design system — and to your site’s content. Unlike generic pattern libraries that give you patterns you have to restyle and rewrite from scratch, Strakture reads your theme’s CSS variables and understands what your site is about, then creates patterns that look native and feel relevant from the first click.

Running a restaurant? Generated patterns use food and dining imagery with copy that fits your industry. Launching a SaaS? Patterns arrive with tech-forward headlines and product-appropriate visuals. Your theme, your niche, one click.

Stop spending hours on generic patterns. Generate professional, on-brand layouts in seconds with Strakture.

The Problem with Generic Patterns

Every WordPress developer knows the pain: you find a great pattern, insert it, and then spend two hours manually matching colors, adjusting fonts, fixing spacing, and making it look like it belongs on your site. Multiply that by every section on every page, and you’ve lost a full day to style matching.

Strakture solves this by reading your theme’s actual design tokens — the CSS variables that define your site’s look — and generating patterns that use those exact values. Patterns arrive ready to publish, not ready to customize.

Theme-Matched, Site-Aware AI Patterns

Strakture analyzes two things before generating a pattern: your theme’s design system and your site’s context. It reads your theme’s CSS variables to apply your exact colors, typography, and spacing — then it uses your site’s niche to generate copy and select images that actually fit.

A portfolio site gets clean, minimal layouts with professional imagery. A fitness studio gets bold, energetic sections with workout visuals. A law firm gets formal, trust-building structures with appropriate language. Same AI, tuned to your site — not a one-size-fits-all template.

Works with 15+ popular WordPress block themes including:

  • Kadence
  • Astra
  • Neve
  • Blocksy
  • GeneratePress
  • OceanWP
  • Twenty Twenty-Four
  • Twenty Twenty-Three
  • Any theme using standard WordPress design tokens (theme.json)

Browse the Full Pattern Library (Free)

Every Strakture user gets access to the complete pattern library — no account required. Browse hundreds of professionally designed block patterns across every common page section:

  • Hero sections and full-width banners
  • Features grids and service listings
  • Pricing tables and comparison layouts
  • Testimonial sections and social proof blocks
  • Team member grids and about sections
  • Contact and call-to-action sections

Browse with infinite scroll, preview patterns in your site’s context, and insert original patterns into any page or post with a single click.

AI Generation (Premium)

Upgrade to unlock AI-powered pattern generation. Instead of inserting a generic pattern and manually styling it to match your brand, Strakture generates a version matched to your theme’s design system and your site’s content — the right colors, relevant copy, and contextually appropriate images, all in one click.

A restaurant gets a hero section with dining imagery and a reservation CTA. A digital agency gets a features grid showcasing services. The AI understands what your site is about and generates accordingly.

Describe further customizations in plain English before generating: “Dark background, 3-column layout, add a subtitle.” Claude AI applies your changes while keeping everything aligned with your theme. No prompt engineering required.

Free vs. Premium Features

Free — Browse and Insert

  • Full access to the Strakture pattern library
  • Infinite scroll pattern browsing
  • Pattern categories (Hero, Features, Pricing, Testimonials, and more)
  • One-click insertion of original patterns into the block editor
  • Preview patterns in your site’s context before inserting
  • Works with any WordPress block theme

Premium — AI Generation

  • AI-generated theme-matched patterns (your exact colors, fonts, spacing)
  • Natural language customization — describe changes before generating
  • Unsplash image integration — relevant images auto-downloaded to your media library with attribution
  • Select and generate multiple patterns at once
  • Credits rollover protection — upgrade or downgrade any time

Plans:

  • Starter: 50 AI generations/month ($19/mo)
  • Pro: 200 AI generations/month ($49/mo)
  • Agency: 1,000 AI generations/month ($199/mo)

How to Use

Inserting a Pattern (Free):

  1. Edit or create a new page or post in the WordPress block editor
  2. Click the “Strakture Patterns” button in the editor toolbar
  3. Browse by category or scroll through the pattern library
  4. Click any pattern to insert it directly into your content

Generating a Theme-Matched Pattern (Premium):

  1. Open the Strakture library from the editor toolbar
  2. Browse to a pattern you like
  3. Optionally describe customizations in the prompt field
  4. Click Generate — Strakture sends your theme data to the AI and returns a theme-matched version

No Lock-In

Strakture generates standard WordPress blocks — core/group, core/columns, core/image, and every other native block type. If you ever cancel or deactivate the plugin, every pattern you’ve inserted stays on your site as regular, fully editable content. No proprietary format. No data held hostage.

Lightweight by Design

Strakture adds no frontend scripts or styles to your site. The pattern library UI loads only when opened in the editor. Generated patterns are standard WordPress blocks — no performance overhead, no extra HTTP requests for visitors.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • A WordPress block theme (FSE-compatible)

External services

This plugin connects to the Strakture API (https://api.strakture.com), a service operated by Aleksandr Samokhin, to serve the block pattern library and AI generation features.

Strakture API (api.strakture.com)

What it is: The Strakture backend that provides the pattern library content and AI-powered pattern generation displayed inside the block editor.

What data is sent and when:

  • Loading pattern categories — When the pattern library is opened, the plugin fetches the list of available categories. The request includes the WordPress version and the site’s language (locale).
  • Loading patterns — When browsing patterns, the plugin fetches paginated pattern data for the selected category. The request includes the WordPress version, the site’s language (locale), the selected category, and the current page number.
  • Generating patterns (Premium only) — When a user generates a theme-matched pattern, the plugin sends theme design token data (CSS variables for colors, typography, spacing) and the Freemius license key to the API. No personal data or user information is transmitted.

No personal data or user information is transmitted for free features. The WordPress version and locale are sent solely to serve compatible, correctly localized patterns.

Terms of service: https://strakture.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://strakture.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/strakture directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit or create a new page to see the “Strakture Patterns” button in the editor toolbar.
  4. Click the button to open the pattern library and start browsing.
sections.faq:
Will this work with my theme?

Strakture works with 15+ popular WordPress block themes including Kadence, Neve, Astra, Blocksy, and GeneratePress. It also works with any theme that uses WordPress’s standard design token system (theme.json). Install the free version to test with your theme — browsing and inserting original patterns is always free.

Is there a free version?

Yes. The free version gives you full access to browse the Strakture pattern library and insert original patterns into any page or post. Upgrade to a paid plan to unlock AI-generated theme-matched patterns.

How is Strakture different from other WordPress pattern plugins?

Most pattern libraries give you a collection of pre-built patterns that you have to manually restyle to match your site — changing colors, adjusting fonts, fixing spacing. Strakture reads your theme’s actual CSS variables and generates patterns that use your exact design tokens. The result looks like you built it from scratch.

How does the AI customization work?

Before generating, you can optionally describe modifications in plain English. For example: “Make the heading larger, add a subtitle, change to 3 columns.” Claude AI regenerates the pattern with your changes while keeping your theme’s design system. No prompt engineering required — conversational instructions work.

What happens to patterns if I cancel?

Nothing — they stay on your site. Strakture generates standard WordPress blocks. You can edit, move, or delete them like any other content. No lock-in, no proprietary format.

Can I customize patterns after inserting them?

Absolutely. Once inserted, patterns become regular WordPress blocks. You have full editing control — change text, swap images, adjust spacing, add or remove elements — just like any other block content.

Do you support Elementor or Divi?

Strakture generates native WordPress blocks, not page builder elements. It works best with block themes (FSE) like Kadence, Astra, and Twenty Twenty-Four. If you’re using Elementor or Divi, you’ll need to use their native pattern systems.

Are the Unsplash images free to use commercially?

Yes. All Unsplash images are licensed for commercial use. Strakture automatically downloads images to your WordPress media library and generates proper photographer attribution, ensuring compliance with Unsplash’s terms.

What counts as a “pattern generation”?

Each time you click Generate to create a theme-matched AI version of a pattern, it uses one credit. Browsing the library and inserting original (non-AI) patterns is free and never uses credits.

Do credits roll over?

Credits reset each month on your billing date. Unused credits don’t roll over, but you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.

Will Strakture slow down my website?

No. Strakture adds no frontend scripts or styles to your site. The library UI loads only inside the WordPress block editor, and only when you open it. Inserted patterns are standard WordPress blocks — no additional performance overhead for visitors.

What WordPress themes work best with Strakture?

Strakture is optimized for any WordPress block theme that uses theme.json for design tokens. It has specific support for Kadence, Astra, Neve, Blocksy, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Twenty Twenty-Four, Twenty Twenty-Three, and 10+ others. Any FSE-compatible block theme will work.
